verdict.rationale: Unstructured documents batch-oriented processing: source-connector workflows (e.g. Azure Blob, Databricks Volumes) that move documents from source to destination, job APIs to trigger runs, monitor status and inspect failed files, and multi-file handling in sample scripts. Per-page pricing and dedicated instances suggest it is built for volume. However, nothing in the evidence documents rate limits, throughput figures, or behavior at millions of pages. missing for 10: documented API rate limits/quotas, stated throughput or SLA figures, evidence of million-page-scale runs, independent corroboration of predictable performance at scale.
